test_title: PYST 40: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A dealer purchased an oven for ₹54,000. He allows a discount of 10% on its marked price and still gains 75%. Find the marked price of the oven.
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (C.P) = ₹54,000

Discount = 10%

Gain = 75%

**Formula used:**

Marked Price (M.P) = Selling Price (S.P) / (1 - Discount / 100)

Selling Price (S.P) = Cost Price (C.P) × (1 + Gain / 100)

**Calculation:**

S.P = C.P × (1 + Gain / 100)

⇒ S.P = 54,000 × (1 + 75 / 100)

⇒ S.P = 54,000 × 1.75

⇒ S.P = ₹94,500

M.P = S.P / (1 - Discount / 100)

⇒ M.P = 94,500 / (1 - 10 / 100)

⇒ M.P = 94,500 / 0.90

⇒ M.P = ₹1,05,000

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
